summary: Iter44 / Phase T full-stack verification. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (/api/boat-pros/mine auth+404+photos array, PATCH /api/boat-pros/photos persist/dedupe/cap-6/400KB-reject/403/401/clear, /api/handle/available taken+suggestions+handle_enum_log write, free/invalid no-log, 30/60s rate limit, admin contact reply with template body incl. 401/403 guards). Frontend: ProPhotosUploader renders in Profile for boat_pro with 6 slots + file input and a real upload + delete round-trip persists via PATCH; Onboarding name-derived autofill chip row and taken-handle suggestion pills both render and populate the handle input; /@captainjane alias route renders HandleProfile (Captain Jane / @captainjane), /notarealroute redirects to /, /u/:handle still works; AdminContact reply template <select> populates the textarea and POST .../reply returns 200 with 'Reply sent.' toast. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Spec value 'zz_no_such_handle_xxx' is 21 chars so it returns reason:'invalid' (not ok:true) — the 3-20 char regex is working as designed; test adjusted to a 20-char free handle and a separate 21-char invalid case. No code change needed.

Response 'ok' mirrors email-delivery success, so a mailer outage returns ok:false with HTTP 200 even though the reply was persisted. Frontend keys its toast off ok — consider separating persistence vs delivery status.

integration_issues.issue: The autofill useEffect fires up to 4 sequential GET /api/handle/available calls on mount; combined with the 30-req/60s per-IP throttle, users behind shared NAT (or a user re-typing) can hit 429 and silently lose availability feedback (catch block swallows the error, no user-visible state).

issues: Template picker uses a native browser <select> rather than the shadcn Select used elsewhere — inconsistent styling
Select keeps showing 'Pick a template…' after a template is applied (no selected-state feedback)

action_items: Optional: debounce/limit the Onboarding autofill availability probes (or surface a 'try again' state on 429) to avoid silently swallowing rate-limit errors.
Optional: return persistence success separately from email delivery in POST /api/admin/contact/{id}/reply.
Optional: replace the native template <select> in AdminContact with the shadcn Select for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: directory_router.py: `from typing import List` import blocker is resolved; GET /boat-pros/mine is correctly declared before /boat-pros/{pro_id} so the literal path is not shadowed.

App.js HandleAtAlias correctly guards on the leading '@' and Navigate-redirects everything else, but the catch-all now sits behind a dynamic segment — any new top-level static route must be registered ABOVE /:atHandle or it will be swallowed.

ProPhotosUploader silently drops files >400KB after showing a toast but still saves the rest; acceptable, though the file input is not cleared when every file is rejected (save() is still called with the unchanged array).
All new endpoints exclude _id and derive identity from the session token (no user_id in the URL) — good.
seed_data_creation: Minted temporary mongo sessions for pro.marina@sailmorenow.dev and captain.jane@sailmorenow.dev; created a temporary onboarding user 'Test Sailor' (test.sailor.iter44@sailmorenow.dev, onboarding_complete=false), a TEST_iter44_admin (platform_role=admin) and one TEST contact message. All removed afterwards; seed_marina boat_pros.photos restored to its original 2 Unsplash URLs.
test_credentials: Emergent Google OAuth only — sessions minted directly in mongo per /app/auth_testing.md. Seeded users listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (both files present and accurate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_phase_t.py (mints its own sessions via pymongo; run with `-n 0` because the handle rate-limit test bursts 30+ requests and sleeps 61s — total runtime ~70s). Mongo session-mint helper for UI runs: /app/backend/tests/seed_iter44_ui.js. Remember /api/handle/available is throttled 30/60s per IP and the preview ingress shares one egress IP, so space out backend + browser handle tests. Boat-pro photo tests mutate db.boat_pros for seed_marina and restore via a class fixture.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect reproduced. The only spec mismatch (zz_no_such_handle_xxx returning invalid instead of ok:true) is caused by the handle regex cap of 20 characters — the requested probe string is 21 characters long, so the endpoint short-circuits to reason:'invalid' before any DB lookup, which is correct behaviour.
